token-movement.settings.animationMode.hi: Control how token movement animation behaves.
token-movement.settings.speedValue.name: Animation Speed Value
token-movement.settings.speedValue.hint: In Fixed mode: total animation duration in milliseconds regardless of distance (lower = faster). In Percentage mode: percent of default speed (100 = normal, 50 = slower, 200 = faster). Ignored in Default/Disabled modes.
When enabled, short moves are proportionally faster than the configured speed. Moves at or above the threshold distance use the configured speed. Only applies in Fixed or Percentage mode.
token-movement.settings.distanceThreshol: Distance in grid spaces at or above which the token moves at the configured speed. Below this distance, speed increases proportionally.
token-movement.settings.suppressMovement: Prevent fog of war from being revealed during token movement animation. FOW is only updated at the final position after the animation ends.
